evals.prompt: I need to generate requirements for version 2.0.0. Where should requirements.md live and how do I find the project harness?
evals.expected_output: Agent reads session-boot and artifact-layout; uses {version_san}; paths under docs/versions/{version_san}/sdd/requirements.md.

evals.prompt: Under /ns-spec-driven I need to generate tasks. task-writer-agent exists in .cursor/agents/. Can I just inline task generation in this session, or must I spawn it?
evals.expected_output: Agent cites subagent-dispatch.md Default: one session — task generation runs in-session by reading ns-spec-driven/references/task-generator.md; task-writer-agent is spawned only if the user explicitly asks. Does not spawn just because the bridge exists.

evals.prompt: /ns-spec-driven Tasks: the user explicitly asked for a subagent for task files; I will Task(inherit) a worker titled task-writer-agent so it stays Grok like this session.
evals.expected_output: subagent-dispatch.md: user request makes a spawn allowed, but Task inherit / persona stand-ins are FORBIDDEN. Child must be the named bridge with YAML model from manifest. Stop; tell human /task-writer-agent if platform cannot spawn that name.

evals.prompt: Review gate: I will Task(subagent_type=reviewer, model=inherit) because Cursor lists reviewer. Coder work: Task(coder).
evals.expected_output: subagent-dispatch.md Cursor Task trap: platform reviewer/coder are not harness bridges. Default is in-session for review and coding (ns-reviewer / ns-coder); no spawn unless the user explicitly asks. If the user did ask and the exact bridge type is missing from the Task enum, stop and ask human to invoke /reviewer-agent or /coder-agent rather than using inherit/platform personas.
Routes to references/prepare.md; boot summary then architecture-rules → sync → brownfield → reverse-spec → agents-md without confirmation gate; no separate worker skills.

evals.prompt: /ns-spec-driven Quick: fix one typo in README — one file. coder-agent bridge exists.
evals.expected_output: Follow ns-coder in-session; MUST NOT spawn coder-agent even when bridge present. Review only if user asks, also in-session (ns-reviewer).

evals.prompt: /ns-harness generate architecture rules for this project
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/architecture-rules-generator.md; writes .nextstage-harness/rules/architecture-rules.md; runs harness sync. Does not run full prepare unless asked.

evals.prompt: /ns-harness prepare this repo — I'm on a feature branch and project-rules.md declares 'Context regeneration branch: develop'.
evals.expected_output: Boot branch check fails: stops, names declared branch(es), writes no docs/context/** files, no rules/AGENTS.md changes.

evals.prompt: /ns-harness prepare on the declared regeneration branch, nothing in the code changed since the last run.
evals.expected_output: Runs full prepare; deterministic output — files whose content did not change are not rewritten (no date/counter bump), git diff stays empty.
